name: Hugo Richer
notes: Senator for Frente Guasu / Convergencia Popular Socialista (2013-2023); co-sponsor of the 2021 emergency education wealth tax bill and 2020 Tasa Covid.

name: Pedro Santa Cruz
notes: Senator for Partido Democrático Progresista (PDP, 2013-2023); co-sponsor of the 2021 emergency education wealth tax bill.

name: Víctor Ríos
role: Ministro de la Corte Suprema de Justicia; former Senador de la Nación (2018-2021)
location: Paraguay > Alto Paraná > Dr. Raúl Peña
notes: Senator for PLRA (2018-2021); co-sponsor of the 2021 emergency education wealth tax bill; appointed Minister of the Supreme Court of Justice of Paraguay in November 2021.

name: Esperanza Martínez
notes: Senator for Frente Guasu (2013-present); Minister of Public Health (2008-2012); leader of Frente Guasu in Senate; sponsored the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax.

name: Carlos Filizzola
notes: Senator for Frente Guasu / País Solidario (2003-2023); former Mayor of Asunción (1991-1996); sponsored the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax.

name: Jorge Querey
notes: Senator for Frente Guasu (2018-2023); medical doctor and professor; defended the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax.

name: Sixto Pereira
notes: Senator for Frente Guasu / Tekojoja (2008-2023); co-promoter of the 2020 Tasa Covid on fortunes > USD 10m.

name: Kattya González
role: Former Senadora de la Nación (2023-2024); former Diputada Nacional (2018-2023)
notes: Diputada for Central (2018-2023) and Senator (2023-2024) for Partido Encuentro Nacional (PEN); defended the solidarity wealth tax in the June 2021 plenary debate.

name: Desirée Masi
notes: Senator for Partido Democrático Progresista (PDP, 2013-2023); medical doctor; defended the wealth tax threshold against opponents claiming it hurt ordinary workers.

name: Blanca Ávalos
notes: General secretary and leader of the teachers union OTEP-SN; spearheaded presentation of the emergency education and wealth tax bill in May 2021.

name: Verónica Serafini Geoghegan
notes: Prominent Paraguayan progressive economist and researcher; adviser to Latindadd; author of op-eds and studies arguing for wealth taxation to finance public services and gender equality.

name: Frente Guasu
notes: Left-wing electoral coalition and political party in Paraguay, founded in 2010; introduced the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax and co-sponsored the 2021 wealth tax bill.

name: OTEP-SN
notes: Organización de Trabajadores de la Educación del Paraguay - Sindicato Nacional; drafted and presented the 2021 bill declaring educational emergency financed by a tax on fortunes > USD 10m.

name: Decidamos
notes: Campaña por la Expresión Ciudadana; civil society association campaigning on tax justice and fiscal equity in Paraguay; member of Latindadd.

name: Fernando Lugo
notes: President of Paraguay (2008-2012) and Senator (2013-2023) for Frente Guasu. Co-sponsored the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax bill (Expediente S-209389 / 120551) in the Senate.

name: Miguel Fulgencio Rodríguez
notes: Senator for Frente Guasu (2018-2023) and former titular of ANDE. Co-sponsored the 2020 Tasa Covid wealth tax bill (Expediente S-209389 / 120551) in the Senate.
